entries.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Input image1 is the STRICT GEOMETRY AND OCCLUSION REFERENCE. Input image2 is the SELECTED MATERIAL/FRAME STYLE REFERENCE. Produce polished game-art concept illustrations by applying image2's refined dark ink-brown card frame and clean pale warm-gray cardstock to the card stacks in image1.
CRITICAL: Copy the exact projected silhouettes, layer order, relative positions, camera projection, number of sheets, and occlusion from image1. These are different card shapes stacked while LYING FLAT ON THE GROUND. Far edges are narrower, near edges wider. Every sheet lies parallel to the ground, centered and almost perfectly aligned. They stack UP in height, never stand upright, never fan open, never spread backward like steps. Match image1's shallow total thickness. No additional sheets, extra lines pretending to be cards, boxes, pedestals, thick wood slabs or metal plates.
R = clipped rectangle. H = six-sided vertical hexagon with one rear peak and one front peak. N = clipped rectangle with the broad actual top-center notch. Do not replace all shapes with rectangles.
Use image2's dark frame band #51463F with outer ink #2B2929 and a very narrow subdued gray-gold highlight #AD9A7D. Faces use opaque pale warm gray #E5DCC9 to #D4C7AD with extremely subtle top-to-bottom shading and minimal clean fibers. Side edges are thin PAPER, pale with narrow dark seams. No distress, scratches, cracks, curled corners, triangular folded flaps, gems, glow, spell pictures, or decorative magic circles.
The underneath cards have complete blank faces. Where a hexagon lies above a rectangle, retain the exposed triangular portions and corners of the rectangle exactly as image1 shows. The lower rectangles must not be cut into hexagons. Where a notched top lies over a lower card, preserve the blank paper visible through its notch; only areas with no card behind are background.
Keep the clearly organized board layout and readable external labels from image1. Never put text or artwork on the cards. Subtle attached ground/contact shadow only. Render sharp, fine but restrained handcrafted gothic-storybook game art, matching image2. This is an art-direction sheet, not a screenshot of an interface. No new invented card arrangements.

This board contains exactly FOUR reusable UNDERCARD BASES in a 2x2 layout, and NO final top card. Each base consists of exactly TWO complete blank cards: top-left RR (rectangle above rectangle), top-right HR (hexagon above rectangle), bottom-left RH (rectangle above hexagon), bottom-right HH (hexagon above hexagon). Preserve all FOUR arrangements from image1, particularly that HR exposes broad lower rectangular corners while RH hides most of the lower hexagon except the front point. These bases will later be covered by a separate actual illustrated top card; do not hollow out their faces. Keep the corresponding RR, HR, RH, HH and U1/U2 labels. Material richness belongs to thin existing edges, not extra embellishments. Render every base equally carefully.

Preserve every cell's exact three silhouettes from image1, including paper visible through N notches and corners visible under H tops.

Keep the same relative top-face and under-layer scale and shallow total pile height as the geometry reference.
